claim: Casa Marcial's address: Calle La Salgar, s/n, 33549 Arriondas, Parres, Asturias — i.e. a hamlet 3 km outside Arriondas town.
quote: Casa Marcial - Calle La Salgar, s/n, 33549 Arriondas, Parres, Asturias, Spain

claim: Casa Marcial does not run its own lodging; the only accommodation it links is the external Narbasu booking.
quote: The site includes a link to 'Book a room in Narbasu' with the notation 'ACCOMMODATION' in the footer section. This appears to be a partnered hotel rather than lodging operated by Casa Marcial itself.

claim: Narbasu is the Manzano siblings' own restaurant-and-hotel, described as 20 minutes from Casa Marcial in a 14th-c. palace.
quote: Narbasu is described as '20 minutes away from Casa Marcial,' situated at a 14th-century palace near the Picos de Europa mountains in Asturias.

claim: Narbasu has 23 rooms (Standard, Special, Junior Suite) in the Palacio de Rubianes at Cereceda, Piloña; open Thursday–Sunday.
quote: Narbasu offers 23 rooms divided into Standard, Special, and Junior Suites categories. Location: Palacio de Rubianes, 33583 Cereceda, Piloña. Hours: Thursday to Sunday.

claim: Narbasu's restaurant holds one Michelin Green Star under chefs Esther and Nacho Manzano.
quote: Narbasu is a restaurant awarded with a MICHELIN Green Star... cuisine of the renowned chefs Esther and Nacho Manzano.

claim: Taxi from Arriondas to Cereceda is roughly 9 minutes and €20–€25.
quote: The fastest way from Arriondas to Cereceda is by taxi, which costs $20 - $25 and takes 9 minutes.

claim: Puebloastur is a 5★ hotel in Cofiño (Parres), awarded 'Gran Lujo' — Asturias's highest hospitality distinction — in 2025.
quote: In 2025 Puebloastur was awarded Gran Lujo status, the highest distinction in Asturian hospitality.

claim: Puebloastur is ~1.8 miles (≈3 km) from Casa Marcial, has 28–30 rooms, a full spa, a 9-m Dalí sculpture, and rates of roughly $512–$814 per night.
quote: 28-30 rooms (boutique property), Cofiño, Parres Municipality. Approximately 1.8-2.6 miles from Casa Marcial restaurant in Arriondas. $512-$814 per night for standard rooms. Original 9-meter Salvador Dalí sculpture on grounds.

claim: Palacio de Cutre is a stone palace with wall, tower and chapel located in La Goleta, Piloña, with seasonal Asturian cuisine on-site.
quote: The palace takes its name from the area of Cutre, 'belonging to the parish of San Pablo de Sorribas at the crossroads of roads from Piloña to Villaviciosa, Colunga and Ribadesella.' On-Site Restaurant: Yes. The establishment features a gastronomy section emphasizing seasonal Asturian cuisine.

claim: Palacio de Cutre averages 9.1/10 on Booking with notably high marks for Staff (9.6) and Comfort (9.3); guests flag GPS difficulty reaching it and no A/C.
quote: Guest ratings are strong across categories, with a 9.1 overall score... Staff (9.6) and Comfort (9.3). The only shortcomings are it's difficult location with GPS, and that they do not have air conditioning.

claim: Hotel Aultre Naray is an 1873 casona in Peruyes (Cangas de Onís), restored in 1995, with chestnut beams, an iron-handrail staircase and Paco Terán interiors.
quote: a casona from 1873 that was rehabilitated in 1995 for use as a hotel... warm designs from Paco Terán's Interior Design Workshop, combined with traditional nineteenth-century Asturian architecture.

claim: Hotel Casona del Sella is a 1923 Indiano-style mansion at Plaza Venancio Pando in central Arriondas, 14 individually-decorated rooms, 83/100 walkability, $87–$129/night for a double.
quote: Plaza Venancio Pando 4, Arriondas... walkability grade of 83/100. The property has 14 rooms total. An old colonial-style 'Indian house' (Indiano architecture)... $87-$129 per night for a standard double room.

claim: La Raposera is a 1917 Indiano mansion in Caravia, rehabilitated 2014, 6 rooms on a 5,000 m² farm, no restaurant on-site, adults/teens 14+ only.
quote: La Raposera rural Hotel is an Indian mansion built around 1917 and rehabilitated as a hotel in 2014... 5,000 m2 farm with gardens and views of the Cantabrian Sea and the Sierra del Sueve... 6 rooms... no restaurant service... only accepts children from 14 years old.

claim: Hotel El Babú is an 18th-c. Asturian manor on the N-632 (km 17) between Ribadesella and Colunga, 7 rooms, buffet breakfast, renewable energy.
quote: Hotel El Babú is situated between Ribadesella and Colunga in Asturias, Spain (Km. 17, N-632, 33343)... 7 total rooms... 18th-century Asturian manor house that has been rehabilitated as a rural hotel.

claim: TripAdvisor's closest-hotels list to Casa Marcial: Puebloastur 1.8 mi, Casona del Sella 2.0 mi, Hotel Rural El Texu 2.8 mi, La Raposera 3.1 mi (5.0★).
quote: Puebloastur Eco-Resort Wellness & Spa — 1.8 miles... Hotel Casona Del Sella — 2.0 miles... Hotel Rural El Texu — 2.8 miles... Hotel La Raposera — 3.1 miles, Rating: 5.0/5 stars.

claim: One Casa Marcial diner used Ribadesella (coastal resort town, ~30 min drive) as a base; the restaurant has parking but car or arranged transport is needed.
quote: The reviewer stayed in Ribadesella, 'a resort town whose beach is enclosed on both sides by mountains, similar to San Sebastian.' This coastal location is about 30 minutes from the restaurant.

claim: Hotel El Quintanal is a renovated Asturian manor in Bode, 2 km from Arriondas, with 11 rooms (2 Junior Suites).
quote: Hotel El Quintanal is an old Asturian manor house completely renovated in 2008 to become a rural hotel. Located in a privileged enclave just 2 km from Arriondas... 11 spacious rooms... 2 rooms being Junior Suites.
